actions.label: edge:node-01 -- node-02: Consumer durables, Energy, Chemicals, Wholesale & retail

narration.name: opening
narration.text: TopoMarket maps market structure and tests whether topology can warn of sharp declines.

narration.name: pair-a
narration.text: Window A, 29 August 2008: 29 of 66 qualifying pairs.

narration.name: pair-b
narration.text: Window B, 10 October 2008: 66 of 66; 37 added, none removed.

narration.name: mapper
narration.text: Mapper places Finance with Manufacturing and Chemicals; Consumer durables is shared across groups.

narration.name: alert
narration.text: 10 March 2025: a recorded alert at percentile 100, versus a frozen threshold of 100.

narration.name: takens
narration.text: The 56-point Takens embedding and the highlighted H1 interval show the shape of recent S&P 500 returns.

narration.name: reveal
narration.text: Reveal: the index stayed above the 10% boundary; maximum decline, 2.02%.

narration.name: late-alert
narration.text: Recorded late alert, included in the evaluation, zero early-warning credit.

narration.name: evidence
narration.text: Three episodes: TDA 0 of 3; VIX 1 of 3. Average precision is low.

narration.name: end
narration.text: Explore the code and the live demo on GitHub.
